text:
Emma: Heads-up — visitor from GreenLabs arriving ~11:30am. Bringing a potted fiddle leaf + a wooden crate. Needs temporary staging and a visitor badge. Any objections to using the lobby staging area? :seedling:
Raj: Lobby shelf ok but it's usually full after deliveries. Maybe the rack near Receiving B?
FrontDeskBot: Package logged: 1x wooden crate (label: "GreenLabs") + 1x potted plant for Maya. Placed on Receiving Rack B. Visitor pre-registered. Temporary badge: teal sticker available at concierge.
Noah: Can we put the plant on the low bench by the window instead of the shelf? Less chance of accidental tipping/water drips. Facilities can help unload if crate is heavy.
Maya: That's mine — thanks for the heads up. I'll bring a tarp and some cardboard to protect the bench. Also can someone save the sunny couch near cafe for our guest from 11:25–12:00?
Emma: Quick poll — react :thumbsup: to save sunny couch 11:25–12:00, :thumbsdown: if you need it.
Raj: :thumbsup:
Noah: :thumbsup:
FrontDeskBot: Visitor arrival checklist: 1) ID scan on arrival 2) temp badge (teal sticker) + name handwritten 3) sign visitor log 4) escort option: Conference Room 2 is free at 11:30.
Maya: Perfect — I'll meet them at concierge and escort to CR2. Also FYI I found a tote in Mailroom 2 labeled "GreenLabs" — left a sticky note.
Emma: Thanks. I'll pin a note on the crate: "fragile / water mat added / escort Maya" and drop Facilities a message for 11:15.
Noah: Facilities ETA 11:10 (they confirmed).
Maya: Saved the couch, thanks everyone :heart:
Emma: Appreciate the quick responses. FrontDeskBot — please mark the crate as fragile in the log and set temp badge color to teal.
FrontDeskBot: Done — crate flagged fragile, visitor badge color set to teal, log entry updated.
Raj: Also left a small sign for the bench: "plant staging — do not move".
Maya: All set on my end, I'll grab the welcome kit and be there by 11:20.
Emma: Awesome. If anything changes, ping here.
_meta: thread about visitor deliveries, badging, temporary seating allocation and package handling
